scenario_invariants.A: The published review opportunity is a strictly positive, finite budget, and it is the budget that ends a cycle: probed immediately on both sides of the candidate's own declared boundary, a recorded pending cycle just inside the budget stays pending while one just outside it is driven to a terminal state and published, and a cycle whose correlated collector still reads active is held open with nothing published just past that budget but is driven to a terminal state and published no later than twice that budget.
scenario_invariants.B: Collector dispatch for an exact head is bounded and idempotent, and every step reads back the durable record production actually published rather than a substituted liveness reading: a first reconcile against an unrecorded head dispatches exactly once and publishes the durable cycle, reconciles observing that record dispatch nothing further, a durable record whose collector produced no run at all -- liveness exactly ("missing", 0) -- and that exceeds the liveness grace recovers exactly one further dispatch, that recovery refreshes the durable record and that exact refreshed record is then reconciled again with nothing aged or substituted in between so a refresh that preserves an already-stale liveness timestamp cannot re-dispatch the same exact head, and a cycle whose real accumulated runs have spent the dispatch budget stays pending rather than dispatching without end.
scenario_invariants.G: A WAITING_FOR_REVIEWER exact-head cycle classifies to pending end-to-end through the real resolution path for absent and in-progress cycle evidence, and malformed cycle evidence fails closed rather than classifying as pending.
